'''Toydarian yeast''' was a type of cooking ingredient.

==Usage==
Toydarian yeast was a powerful rasing agent and could be used in cakes, to make cake layers float above each other. However, if it was used incorrectly, it could become explosive.

==History==
The [[Farghul/Legends|Farghul]] [[Asora]] sold toydarian yeast in [[Asora's Sweet Surprise|her shop]], in [[Hedrett]] on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. Shortly before the wedding of [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren|Lavina Wren]] and [[Jarid DeBell]], Asora sold an extra-rising form of toydarian yeast to a group of [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronians]] and she gave it to them in a sealed container, because it was so reactive. They Devaronians were working for the assassin [[Melo Centris]] and they gave her the yeast, which she used in a poisonous cake that she was making, to kill DeBell at the wedding.
